justification: Assessment returned INVALID but targeted line 0687 (the displayed inequality in the Bloch-Kato deduction of Theorem finiteness case (2)), not the ground-truth defect, which is the falsity of Lemma metabelian_injectivity (line 0531: ad(v) injective on gr_i for the quotient-by-a-Sym-module construction; witness L=F/(Sym*[x,[x,y]]), v=x, a=[x,y]). The assessment in fact explicitly certified lines 0530-0566 (metabelian_injectivity / silly_injectivity) as correct, so it is not a rephrasing of the ground truth. I checked its own flaw concretely and it is genuine as a defect in the written argument: at 0687 the RHS is dim W_i - dim(W_i \cap gr_i(U_n)^{c=1}) = dim W_i^{c=-1}, whereas the lemma at 0676 gives dim H^1_f(G_{Q,T},W) = dim D_dR(W)/F^0 - dim H^0(G_R,W) = dim D_dR(W)/F^0 - dim W^{c=1}, so the lower bound the text can actually derive is dim W_i^{c=1} = dim W_i - dim W_i^{c=-1}. The two superscripts give different numbers on any W_i whose eigenspace dimensions differ, and the printed version is not implied. The dependence is load-bearing: line 0689 cites silly_injectivity, which only yields the injection W_i^{c=-1} -> W_{i+1}/W_{i+1}^{c=-1}, i.e. positivity of dim W_i^{c=1}, not of the printed RHS; and the parallel step for case (1) at line 0629 uses c=-1, confirming the inconsistency. So the printed step does not hold up as written (it is repairable by flipping the superscript, but as printed neither the inequality nor its use is supported).
